exceptions.detail: Boston Planning's downloadable 3D Smart Model has not been acquired and its downstream redistribution grant has not been confirmed.
No latest-and-best LiDAR/DEM tile manifest, payload, metadata, geoid grid, or checksum set exists.
2025 MassGIS imagery has not passed contractor-rights review or been checksum-pinned; older 2011/2012 imagery is explicitly non-distributable.
Building, roads, harbor, parks, and transit candidates have not been downloaded or clipped due disk constraints.
Required landmark models have not passed item-level provenance, rights, geometry, and freshness validation.
No 3D Tiles, glTF, KTX2, collision, navigation, SBOM, signatures, or traversal/visual/performance evidence exists.
CDN/signing credentials, two-person approvals, and named physical-GPU benchmark hardware are unavailable.
